`billing-api` and `pricing-svc` are still degraded. Their next rollback targets are both from 2026-09-13, so I'll roll each back once more.

Eight of the nine degraded `prod` services are now healthy. `notify-worker` is still degraded because its only earlier release is too old to roll back to.

- **Rolled back twice:** `billing-api` and `pricing-svc`. The first rollback landed on a release that was also degraded.
- **Left alone:** `notify-worker`. Its next rollback would return to a release from 2026-09-01, before the 2026-09-10 cutoff. It stays on the degraded release `r-111`.

I checked the status of every rolled-back service after its last rollback. All of them show a healthy live release. I didn't touch `staging` or deploy anything.

I wrote `/app/rollback-report.json` with the eight rolled-back commits and `notify-worker` under `needs_attention`. I also wrote `/app/STATUS.json` with status `partial`, because `notify-worker` is unresolved. Both files parse as valid JSON.
